name: pull-cord
title: Pull Cord
description: A lamp switch shaped like a pendant light. Dragging the bead below the shade stretches a simulated cord until it clicks, lighting the bulb and inverting the card, and the cord swings back when released.
use: A playful theme or product wants an on/off control that is a small moment in itself.
avoid: Touch or precision-critical settings: the drag threshold and small bead make toggling fiddly.
a11y: A hidden switch carries the label and checked state with a visible focus box on the bead; reduced motion drops the swing. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A tall rounded card, white when lit and near-black when off, holds a thin ceiling wire, a dark conical shade and a warm yellow bulb beneath it. A slim cord with a small rounded bead hangs to one side, and the label plus an On or Off line sit at the bottom.
behaves: Pulling the bead down stretches the cord with growing resistance; once it is pulled far enough the switch toggles at once, the card, shade and bulb swap colour, and an extra tug is needed for the next click. Released, the cord swings and settles on a short physics chain.
customise: The label, controlled checked state and change callback are props; the cord physics, lamp drawing and size are fixed in the source.
weight: moderate: A twelve-link Verlet chain runs only while the cord is being pulled or swinging back.
